resume.headline: Data Engineer
resume.summary: Data Engineer with 4+ years of experience building Python ingestion pipelines, orchestrated batch loads, and tested SQL transformation models on cloud data warehouses. Consolidated 40+ regional sources into Snowflake datasets covering roughly 5 million reporting records and reduced recurring reporting errors by more than 90% through automated reconciliation. Holds an M.S. in Applied Computer Science and DP-203 and AWS Cloud Practitioner certifications.

bullets.label: Pipeline Ownership
bullets.text: Owns end-to-end ingestion for a small-business data platform, loading sales, inventory, product, and vendor records from CSV and spreadsheet sources into PostgreSQL with Python and Pandas.

bullets.label: History Modeling
bullets.text: Designs normalized PostgreSQL tables and an append-only count history with indexed lookups and update triggers, replacing 7 paper and spreadsheet logs with one governed source.

bullets.label: Validated Migration
bullets.text: Migrates 8 legacy CSV exports into dated history rows, parsing free-text thresholds into numeric par levels and quarantining unparseable counts in a manual-review queue.

bullets.label: Recurring Automation
bullets.text: Automates weekly and monthly data preparation with repeatable Python and SQL jobs, so business reviews run on current data without manual spreadsheet consolidation.

bullets.label: Analytics Serving
bullets.text: Exposes reusable SQL views joining transactions, products, vendors, and inventory snapshots to Power BI, giving owners reorder and slow-moving-stock reporting for purchasing.

bullets.label: Repository Extraction
bullets.text: Engineered a static-analysis extraction pipeline with Python AST and regex parsers across 4 languages, converting raw repositories into structured metadata consumed by LLM agents.

bullets.label: Reproducible Datasets
bullets.text: Built validated experiment datasets with Python, Pandas, and SQL, standardizing preprocessing and feature generation so model comparisons reran identically across experiments.

bullets.label: Benchmark Reporting
bullets.text: Benchmarked 2 agent SDKs across 3 LLMs on context handling, tool integration, and response quality, publishing the comparison in a co-authored research paper.

bullets.label: Source Consolidation
bullets.text: Engineered Azure Data Factory ingestion and Databricks PySpark transformations consolidating 40+ regional SQL Server sources into Snowflake datasets covering roughly 5 million reporting records.

bullets.label: Dimensional Modeling
bullets.text: Modeled fact tables, conformed dimensions, and star schemas with standardized business keys, giving reporting teams consistent definitions for cross-region workload analysis.

bullets.label: Reconciliation Testing
bullets.text: Automated source-to-target validation and reconciliation tests between raw and curated layers, reducing recurring reporting errors by more than 90% across published datasets.

bullets.label: Incremental Processing
bullets.text: Orchestrated incremental loads and controlled backfills over partitioned Parquet on Amazon S3 with AWS Glue, absorbing corrected measurements without rebuilding full history.

bullets.label: Failure Recovery
bullets.text: Monitored daily pipeline runs with Amazon CloudWatch alerts and retries, tracing schema changes and source outages to restore failed loads and validate corrected outputs.

bullets.label: Release Workflow
bullets.text: Shipped pipeline changes through Git and Azure DevOps with code reviews and automated checks, keeping transformation logic and configurations traceable across releases.

bullets.label: Capacity Analytics
bullets.text: Delivered curated utilization history from Databricks into Snowflake for an 80% threshold dashboard, enabling proactive upgrades that cut storage-related escalations by 25%.

bullets.label: Batch Orchestration
bullets.text: Orchestrated PySpark batch transformations over the public Instacart orders dataset with Apache Airflow DAGs, producing analysis-ready tables for basket and reorder analysis.

bullets.label: Table Modeling
bullets.text: Modeled order, product, and department data into Parquet tables with Spark SQL so reorder-rate and basket-size queries ran without reprocessing raw CSV files.

bullets.label: Quality Gates
bullets.text: Architected a 4-stage LLM pipeline with JSON Schema structured outputs and deterministic lint gates that reject unsupported numbers, weak verbs, and unbacked claims before delivery.

bullets.label: Evaluation Harness
bullets.text: Evaluated pipeline output across 20 labeled job descriptions with automated metrics for classification accuracy, tool recall, and unsupported claims, plus an LLM recruiter-judge rubric.

Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)

emails.body:
Hi Hiring Team,
Greetings of the day.

I am Vamshi Krishna, a Data Engineer with over four years of experience building Python ingestion pipelines and tested SQL transformation models for reporting. I hold a master's degree in Applied Computer Science and am interested in the Data Analyst position at Fieldstone Retail.

At DXC Technology, I engineered Azure Data Factory and Databricks pipelines that consolidated 40+ regional sources into Snowflake datasets, automated reconciliation checks that reduced recurring reporting errors by more than 90%, and owned recovery of failed loads. At LAMA Desserts, I own the full pipeline for a small business, from CSV ingestion to the SQL views behind its reporting. This experience aligns with your need for someone who builds the pipelines feeding your reporting and owns them end to end.

I have attached my resume for your consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to learn more about this role and your team, and I look forward to hearing from you regarding the next steps in the hiring process.

Best regards,
